newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian June Employment Dept jobs indicator up.
newsitem.headline: Australian June Employment Dept jobs indicator up.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment rose to minus 0.264 in June from minus 0.351 in May, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
"The current revision to the ... leading indicator provides strong evidence of a trough in November, 1996," the department said in its monthly release.
The May indicator was revised from minus 0.343 in the June release.
The indicator is an amalgam of seven statistical series, including vehicle registrations, housing approvals and job vacancies.
Since the early 1980s, it has consistently anticipated turns in the labour market -- beginning to rise or fall before employment does -- but with highly variable lags.
